mappings.reason: Concentrating characterized regolith is an application of existing mineral-separation processes; alternate suitable gravity concentration remains available under qualified acceleration.
Off-world melt qualification applies existing vacuum melting with local containment, energy and solidification constraints; the location does not create a second melting discovery.
Extreme-distance receiver analysis extends the shared link-budget mechanism with actual source assumptions, aperture, noise and observation time; it is not a second law of signal propagation.

prior_branch_corrections.change: Remove mandatory solar arrays and eclipse storage from every surface power route; permit qualified fission-electric generation with real site-specific operating requirements.

scope_distinctions.distinction: Atmospheric launch/recovery architecture, condition-based flight release, repeated in-space transfer and surface-orbit transport have different operating envelopes. Orbital reuse does not require an atmospheric heat shield.
Low-temperature storage, powered heat removal and integrated orbital stock delivery differ; reduced boiloff is conditional on real power and heat rejection.
